About this Project

Laos Energy Atlas

The Interactive Hydropower Map is a web-based Geographic Information System (Web GIS) developed to improve access to geospatial information related to hydropower infrastructure in the Lao People's Democratic Republic. The platform provides an intuitive and interactive environment for exploring the locations of hydropower dams, visualizing spatial data, and supporting research and decision-making through an interactive map interface.

Currently, this application focuses exclusively on hydropower dams and related infrastructure. It does not yet include other renewable or clean energy sectors such as solar, wind, biomass, or geothermal energy. These may be incorporated in future versions of the platform as additional datasets become available.

Designed with accessibility and usability in mind, the application enables researchers, policymakers, students, development partners, and the general public to better understand the geographic distribution of hydropower dams across Laos.

Reading the dam names

Many dams share a river name with a number after it — e.g. Nam Ngiep 1, 2, 3, or Nam Khong 1, 2, 3. The number identifies a separate hydropower project built along the same river (often as part of a cascade of several dams on one waterway), not a capacity ranking or a technical index. Two dams named "X 1" and "X 2" are two different physical dams on the same river, sometimes built years apart by different developers.

Key Features

  • Interactive satellite-based web map
  • Zoom, pan, and navigation tools
  • Search functionality for hydropower dam locations
  • Layer management for spatial datasets
  • Interactive pop-up information displaying dam attributes
  • Responsive interface for desktop and mobile devices
  • Geospatial data visualization using open-source GIS technologies

Project Objective

This project demonstrates how web-based geospatial technologies can improve access to hydropower information through an interactive digital platform. By transforming spatial datasets into an accessible Web GIS application, the project supports education, research, spatial analysis, and informed decision-making related to hydropower development in the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

While the current version focuses on hydropower dams, the platform is designed with the potential to incorporate additional renewable energy datasets in future developments.

Acknowledgement

This project was developed as part of the Clean Energy Internship Programme organized by EnergyLab Asia and supported by the Australian Government through Australian Aid.

Although the internship focuses on clean energy, the scope of this Web GIS application is currently limited to hydropower dam mapping in Laos. The project reflects collaborative efforts to strengthen digital innovation, geospatial capacity, and data accessibility for the country's energy sector.

Technologies

  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • JavaScript
  • Leaflet.js
  • GeoJSON
  • OpenStreetMap / Satellite Basemap
  • QGIS
  • Python

Thank you for visiting the Interactive Hydropower Map of Laos. We hope this platform serves as a valuable resource for exploring the spatial distribution of hydropower infrastructure and contributes to future research, planning, and sustainable energy development in the Lao People's Democratic Republic.
